name: NavList
statusNote: Alpha in Primer React's docs file, yet it drives GitHub's repository settings and side navigation. The visuals are ActionList's; NavList adds link semantics, sub-navigation and the current-item treatment. A 2px item gap sits behind a feature flag that defaults off.
summary: A vertical list of links for moving between pages of a section, with one current item marked by an accent line, optional groups with headings, collapsible sub-navigation up to four levels deep, and a "Show more" expander. Choose it over UnderlineNav when the destinations are many or hierarchical, and over ActionList when the items navigate rather than act.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: The rows, in order: items, groups and dividers. An item is {label, href, current, leadingVisual, trailingVisual, description, trailingAction, inactiveText, tooltipText, subItems, defaultOpen}; a group is {title or heading, hideDivider, items}.

inputs.name: heading
inputs.description: NavList.Heading: names the nav landmark. Level h2 (default) or h3; groups default one level deeper. visuallyHidden keeps it for assistive technology only.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Names the nav landmark when there is no heading; a caller-supplied label or labelledby wins over the heading.

inputs.name: current
inputs.description: Per item: its aria-current value. Any value except false makes the item the current one. location marks an ancestor of the current page.

inputs.name: subItems
inputs.description: Per item: a NavList.SubNav of nested items. The item becomes a disclosure button and stops being a link.

inputs.name: defaultOpen
inputs.description: Per item with subItems: open on first render. An item whose sub-tree holds the current item opens regardless.

inputs.name: inactiveText
inputs.description: Per item: why the item cannot be used. The item renders muted, ignores activation, and shows the text.

inputs.name: tooltipText
inputs.description: Per item: a tooltip shown east of the item after the medium delay.

inputs.name: trailingAction
inputs.description: Per item: {icon, label, href} for an invisible IconButton (a Button when icon is absent) at the item's end, outside the link.

inputs.name: groupExpand
inputs.description: NavList.GroupExpand: hidden items revealed by a "Show more" row, with label (default "Show more") and pages (default 0, meaning reveal all at once).

inputs.name: disableItemGap
inputs.description: Suppress the 2px gap between items when the item-gap feature flag is on.

inputs.name: onNavigate
inputs.description: Activation of a link item (the href navigates by default).

anatomy.name: Nav landmark
anatomy.description: The outer navigation region, named by the heading or the caller's label.

anatomy.name: Heading
anatomy.description: A small heading above the list, indented 16px so it lines up with item labels.

anatomy.name: List
anatomy.description: An inset ActionList: 8px block padding, items inset 8px from each side so the current-item line has room to their left.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.description: A rounded row (link, or disclosure button for a parent) with a grid of spacer, leading visual and content; the content is label, trailing visual and trailing action.

anatomy.name: Leading visual
anatomy.description: A 16px octicon in --fgColor-muted, centred in a 20px-tall box.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Medium body text, normal weight, 20px line height, wrapping by word; semibold when current.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.description: Small muted text at a 16px line height, inline after the label or as a block below it.

anatomy.name: Trailing visual
anatomy.description: An icon or count at the end of the content. On a parent item it is the expand chevron.

anatomy.name: Expand chevron
anatomy.description: A chevron-down octicon in the trailing-visual slot of an item with sub-items; flipped vertically while open.

anatomy.name: Trailing action
anatomy.description: An invisible IconButton (or Button) after the content, full row height, square on its left corners.

anatomy.name: Current-item line
anatomy.description: A 4px accent bar 8px left of the current item (or of a collapsed parent that holds it), inset 4px top and bottom, medium radius.

anatomy.name: Sub-navigation
anatomy.description: A nested list under a parent item; its items indent 8px per level and use small label text.

anatomy.name: Group heading
anatomy.description: Small semibold muted text above a group, 6px block and 16px inline padding; may hold a link.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.description: A 1px --borderColor-muted rule drawn before each group unless hidden.

anatomy.name: Show more
anatomy.description: A button row labelled "Show more" with a trailing plus icon that reveals the group's hidden items.

variants.description: The group heading is plain muted text.
The group heading sits on a --bgColor-muted band with 1px --borderColor-muted rules above and below and 7px/8px outer margins.
The description follows the label on its baseline, 8px after it.
The description sits below the label, 4px under it; the label turns semibold.

layout.text: The list is ActionList's inset variant: 8px block padding on the list and 8px inline margin on each top-level item; items inside a sub-navigation have no inline margin.

An item row is a grid of spacer, leading visual and content. It pads --control-medium-paddingBlock (6px) top and bottom and --control-medium-paddingInline-condensed (8px) at the sides; each present column is followed by --control-medium-gap (8px).
The label is medium body text at a hard-coded 20px line height, so a one-line row is 32px tall. Long labels wrap by word; nothing truncates.

The content area is a second grid of label, trailing visual and trailing action, with --control-medium-gap after each present column. Visuals sit in a box at least 20px tall with a 20px line height, centred, so they align with the first label line.
A description is small text at a hard-coded 16px line height. Inline, it follows the label on the baseline 8px later; as a block, it sits 4px below the label.

Sub-items indent by a leading spacer of depth x 8px: depth 1 for a parent's children, 2 for theirs, up to 4. The spacer is drawn only inside a parent that has sub-items, and sub-item labels use small body text.
The current-item line is absolutely placed: top 4px, left -8px, width 4px, height the row less 8px, in --borderColor-accent-emphasis with medium radius. It falls in the item's 8px inline margin.
A trailing action makes the row a non-wrapping flex box: the link fills the row and the action button follows it at full row height, with square left corners.

A divider is 1px of --borderColor-muted with 7px above and 8px below; a divider that is the list's first child is hidden. A group draws a divider before itself unless hideDivider, and a group that is not first has 8px above it.

A group heading is small semibold muted text at a hard-coded 18px line height, padded 6px block and 16px inline. The filled variant adds a --bgColor-muted band with 1px rules and 7px/8px outer margins, dropping the top margin when first.

The NavList heading has 8px below it and starts --control-medium-paddingInline-condensed + 8px (16px) in, level with item labels. A link inside a group heading is --fgColor-default and underlines on hover.
With the item-gap flag on (it defaults off) and disableItemGap unset, consecutive items and an open sub-navigation are separated by 2px.

states.text: On a hover-capable pointer the row fills --control-transparent-bgColor-hover and, unless it is current or keyboard-focused, gains a 1px inset ring of --control-transparent-borderColor-active. On a parent item the hover lands on its own row only, never on its sub-items.
The row fills --control-transparent-bgColor-active with the same 1px inset ring unless it is current.
Keyboard focus draws a 2px --focus-outline-color outline at offset 0 with no shadow, and hides the dividers next to the row.

states.label: current
states.text: The current item (aria-current set and not false) fills --control-transparent-bgColor-selected, sets its label semibold in --control-fgColor-rest, and shows the current-item line. Hovering it switches the fill to the hover colour.

A collapsed parent hides its sub-navigation and shows the chevron pointing down. If the current item is inside it, the parent takes the current treatment instead: selected fill, semibold label and the accent line.
An open parent flips its chevron vertically (scaleY -1) with no transition and shows its sub-navigation; it never carries the current treatment itself.

states.label: inactive
states.text: An item with inactiveText renders all its text and visuals in --fgColor-muted, shows a not-allowed cursor, has no hover or press fill, ignores activation, and shows the inactive text.

behaviour.text: A leaf item is a link: pointer release or Enter follows its href. The caller sets which item is current; NavList does not track navigation.
An item with sub-items is a disclosure button, not a link: activation toggles its sub-navigation open or closed. Any href on it is dropped.
A parent starts open when defaultOpen is set or its sub-tree holds the current item, searched recursively. Whenever the sub-tree changes and holds the current item, the parent opens again.
The parent shows the current treatment exactly when it is closed and holds the current item; opening it moves the treatment to the current descendant.
Sub-navigation nests at most four levels; a deeper SubNav renders nothing and logs an error.

Show more reveals hidden items. With pages 0 the first press reveals all and the button goes. With pages N each press reveals ceil(count / N x pressCount) items, and the button goes after the Nth press.
After Show more reveals items, focus moves to the first newly revealed item: the first item on the first press, else the item at the new count less floor(count / N).
A trailing action is a separate control after the link with its own label and tooltip (default direction west); it is not rendered while the item is inactive or loading.
tooltipText shows a tooltip east of the item after the medium delay.
The NavList heading is h2 by default (h3 allowed) and names the landmark; group headings default one level deeper (h3 without a NavList heading) and never go below h4.

accessibility.role: navigation landmark holding a list of links; a parent item is a button with aria-expanded
keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab move through every link, parent button and trailing action in order; NavList has no arrow-key navigation.
Enter or Space toggles a parent item's sub-navigation.
Enter or Space on Show more reveals the next page of items and focuses the first new one.
semantics: The nav is named by the NavList heading unless the caller supplies aria-label or aria-labelledby.
The current link carries aria-current (page, location and so on).
A parent button carries aria-expanded and aria-controls naming its sub-list; the sub-list is labelled by the parent button.
An item is labelled by its label plus its trailing visual and described by its description and, when inactive, its inactive text.
Group headings are real headings one level below the NavList heading.

notes.text: A parent item cannot also be a link: when an item has sub-items, NavList renders a disclosure button and ignores href and the other link props.
A closed sub-navigation stays in the tree and is hidden with display: none; a native build may skip laying it out but must keep its open state.

NavList also finds the current descendant with a DOM query for [aria-current] after layout, for custom link components that set aria-current internally. A native build computes "holds the current item" from its own model.
Show more moves focus with flushSync and a document query for data-expand-focus-target; a native build focuses the first newly revealed item directly after revealing it.
Hover fills apply only under (hover: hover); on a touch pointer only the press fill shows.
The Show more button always reports aria-expanded="false", even after it has revealed items.

The module's focus-visible rule targets the li, which is never focusable; the focused element is the link or button inside it, which no module rule styles. Draw the focusOutline ring (2px --focus-outline-color, offset 0) on the row as the rule intends.

Hard-coded in the module: the 20px label and visual line height, the 16px description line height, the 18px group-heading line height, the 8px-per-level indent, and the 33.333ms linear background transition.

Under forced colours a hovered or pressed row draws a 1px transparent outline, a focused row a 1px transparent outline, and the current row a 2px transparent outline, so the system colours mark each state.
The 2px item gap is behind the primer_react_action_list_item_gap flag, which defaults to false; build without it unless matching a flagged GitHub surface.
Inside the list the current-item line sits 8px outside the row; anything that clips the row's box (a scroll view flush with the item) cuts it off. Keep the list's 8px inline inset.
